generate_shape_scenes: generate Minecraft shape scenes and save segmentation data as a pickle file using argparse CLI
convert_json_to_segdata: convert a JSON scene description with blocks and instance segmentation tags into numpy segmentation arrays
build_shape_scene: build a Minecraft shape scene with configurable scene size, height, ground depth, and max number of shapes
run_scene_generation_cli: run the CLI tool to generate multiple shape scenes with configurable offsets and save paths
review_json_to_segdata: review the json_to_segdata function that maps block locations and instance tags to 3D numpy arrays
